question: Does the instrument hold on a graph that is not legislative, with constraints we did not write?

graph.source: ICIJ Offshore Leaks, Neo4j dump icij-offshoreleaks-5.13.0.dump as published by ICIJ, loaded on 2026-09-10; the typed relations come from the setup queries of pgrepair's own icij-qualitative-study workload

laws.text: two nodes linked by same_name_as carry the same name
an entity with an inactivation date in the past is not Active
an entity has at most one sole director

known_faults_of_the_source.cross_check: our census of I1 on the published dump gives 18,000; pgrepair, run on the untouched dump with her own gamma_1, collects the same number

reconciliation.equals: 18,000 known I1 violations of the source + 22 (one edge of each known I3 pair) + 521 injected visible spurious edges + 60 rival edges

readings: On the one-edge law the two pgrepair algorithms and a rule without a model are identical: 521 of 521 injected visible edges caught, 0 of 521 invisible ones, on both.

On the two-edge law with nothing to separate the two edges, the rule destroys all 60 true edges; pgrepair keeps 24 (ILP) or 25 (Greedy) — 40 % and 41.7 %, a 95 % interval of about +/- 12.5 points on 60 pairs, indistinguishable from a coin. The gain over the rule is minimality, not discrimination.
The two algorithms return solutions of identical cost (weight 37,206, 18,603 deletions) and differ on which edge of one single pair they drop.
The 731 removed president_of edges are beyond the reach of any deletion-only repairer, and the judge says so rather than counting them as failures.
reserves: The blind arm injects rivals onto 60 of the 72 sole_director_of edges the truth holds outside its known faults: the rate is high because the relation is small, and the arbitration, not the rate, is what is measured.
gamma_4 of her workload (a quantified path over 1.7 million officer_of edges) is out of coverage: our law module cannot yet express a variable-length pattern.
This truth is by construction: it is the data ICIJ published, frozen, not a claim about the world. Nothing here is audited against a document.
